```{r}
#| label: tbl-base
#| cache: true
#| cache.comments: false
#| tbl-cap: "Descriptive statistics"
#| tbl-pos: "H"

vars <- names(ndr)
vars <- setdiff(vars, c(
  "debutar", "age", "hba1c", "systoliskt", "diastoliskt",
  "vikt", "langd", "bmi",
  "kolesterol", "triglycerider", "hdl", "ldl",
  "kreatinin", "GFR", "uAlbCreatinine",
  "shareGlucoseLast2W", "shareGlucoseRange", "sdCGMLast2W", "meanGlukosesLast2W", "snuffingEndYear", "slutatrokaar",
  "scb_dispincome"
))
ndrtmp <- ndr %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(vars), as.factor)) %>%
  select(-lopnr, -sos_deathcause, -contains("dtm"))

tab <- CreateTableOne(data = ndrtmp)


default_kable(print(tab, printToggle = FALSE, missing = TRUE, ),
  font_size = 7.5,
  longtable = TRUE,
  row.names = TRUE
)
```
